thread:
meera: Quick heads-up — onboarding mosaicary-v1 quantized int8 shows weird token boundary shifts for JA/KO/ZH in the regen eval, plus an RTL bracket-mirroring glitch for some Arabic samples. BLEU delta ~ -1.8 zh->en on the full set.
chris: ugh can you paste a failing input and the tokens?
meera: repro below:

```
# run eval
python eval.py --model mosaicary-v1 --quant int8 --subset zh-en --samples 2000
```

meera: sample input (shortened): "今日は天気がいいね。明日は..."
meera: tokenized (int8 build decoder input ids): [12, 545, 78, 3456, 90, 2]
meera: tokenized (baseline float decoder input ids): [12, 545, 78, 3456, 91, 2]
chris: that 90 vs 91 looks like a merge/split shift — could be tokenizer config or detokenization aliasing after quant kernels.
sanjay: did we change cldr/normalizer version in the build? last merge bumped normalizer to 1.3.4
meera: yes, normalizer 1.3.4 landed in the int8 build. On float builds we kept 1.3.2
eva: can you run token-level diff on a few failing cases and post the decoded strings? also check bidi bracket mirroring for ar->en samples.
meera: posted diffs to gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/mosaicary-int8-token-diffs (shortlink)
triage-bot: CI run started: https://ci.redwood.ai/12345 (will post artifacts)
chris: also saw bracket mirror flip for RTL sample — "(שלום)" -> ")שלום(" in outputs? that's classic bidi detok mismatch.
meera: exact sample: arabic with parentheses flips in the model output only under quant-int8 inference.
sanjay: hypothesis: the quant runtime's postprocessing uses an older ICU or different bidi rule set, or the detok path uses a different unicode normalization pipeline.
eva: try re-running with explicit NFKC normalization in the eval harness and compare.
meera: re-ran with NFKC forced: BLEU drop improves slightly (from -1.8 to -0.9) but still off.
chris: ok plan: 1) run tokenization parity check between float and int8 builds (no model inference), 2) re-run eval with deterministic detok (NFKC), 3) triage whether normalizer bump caused token id remap, 4) if confirmed, revert normalizer in int8 build for a quick canary.
meera: starting step 1 now, will attach token diffs.
triage-bot: jira ticket created: ML-1723 (mosaicary int8 token/detok parity) assigned to meera
meera: adding minimal repro and priority=high
eva: if it's a detok-only issue we can push a microfix quickly; if tokenization changed then we need a vocab remap and rerun of the embedding hashes.
chris: tagging infra @deploy-bot — can we build an alternate int8 artifact with normalizer 1.3.2 for a quick canary?
meera: @deploy-bot ping
triage-bot: deploy-bot acknowledged, build queued :gear:
meera: thanks — adding failing examples and raw token ids to the ticket. will follow up with diff artifacts and a small evaluation table.
chris: thumbs up. keep short updates here so eng-sre can watch SLA impact.
meera: will do. :thumbsup:
